cohort: 3478 pregnant patients, 1739 with meningioma and 1739 without meningioma
finding: Patients with meningioma were not at higher risk for pregnancy complications, including ectopic/molar pregnancy, cesarean section, abortion, preterm labor, pre-eclampsia/eclampsia, and mortality, compared to their non-meningioma counterparts.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were lower in the meningioma group (7.25%) compared to the non-meningioma group (9.43%), but this difference was not statistically significant.
